Why does price keep returning to the same highs and lows? 🧠

Equal highs and equal lows attract resting orders, like stop-losses. A pool of resting orders is called liquidity. Price sometimes sweeps through it and reverses, but not always.

This is a concept to study, not a signal. Save this for later 🔖

Call और Put: 30 सेकंड में 📈📉

• Call: कीमत बढ़ने पर फ़ायदा
• Put: कीमत गिरने पर फ़ायदा
• Strike: तय कीमत
• Expiry: आख़िरी तारीख़
• Premium: option की कीमत

Price बार-बार उन्हीं High/Low पर क्यों लौटता है? 🧠

Equal highs & lows: where liquidity sits 🎯

Liquidity = resting orders. They cluster near equal highs/lows, previous day high/low, swing points, round numbers and range edges. Price sometimes sweeps them, but not always.

Liquidity sweep vs real breakout ⚖️

Sweep: price pokes beyond a level and closes back inside. Breakout: price closes beyond the level and holds it. Context (trend, timeframe, volume) matters.

Charts are illustrative. No pattern works every time.

एक ट्रेड में कितना रिस्क? 🧮

उदाहरण: पूँजी ₹1,00,000, रिस्क 1% = ₹1,000
Quantity = रिस्क ÷ (Entry − Stop)
Entry ₹250, Stop ₹245 → ₹5 रिस्क → 200 शेयर

काल्पनिक उदाहरण है, ट्रेड आइडिया नहीं। ब्रोकरेज़ और स्लिपेज़ अलग से लगते हैं।

Position sizing in 3 steps 🧮

1. Decide risk per trade (e.g. 1% of capital)
2. Measure the stop distance
3. Size = Risk ÷ Stop distance

After 10 straight losses: ~90.4% of capital is left at 1% risk, ~34.9% at 10% risk. Small risk keeps you in the game.

Imaginary example, not a trade idea.

You don't need to win 70% of your trades 📊

Breakeven win rate = 1 ÷ (1 + R), where R = reward ÷ risk.
• R:R 1:1 → 50%
• R:R 1:2 → 33%
• R:R 1:3 → 25%

Fees and slippage raise these numbers. Risk first.

Breaker block: toota OB ulta kaam karta hai 🔄

Bullish order block bana → candle ne zone ke neeche close kiya (broken) → price wapas zone tak aaya aur reject hua. Toota demand zone ab supply ki tarah kaam kar raha hai. Isse breaker block kehte hain.

Role reversal hai, guarantee nahi. Save karo 📌

Fair Value Gap (FVG) kya hai? 🕳️

3 candles: beech wali bahut lambi. Candle 1 ka high aur candle 3 ka low overlap nahi karte, wahi gap FVG hai. Price aksar baad mein gap bharne wapas aata hai, par har baar nahi.

BOS vs CHoCH 📈📉

BOS (Break of Structure): trend ki direction mein pichla high/low toota, trend continue.
CHoCH (Change of Character): trend ke ulta pehla break, trend badalne ka pehla sign.

Ek CHoCH = pakka reversal nahi. Higher timeframe bhi dekho.

VWAP kya batata hai? 📏

VWAP = Volume Weighted Average Price, intraday ka 'fair price'.
• Price upar = buyers control
• Price neeche = sellers control
• Roz open par reset

Akela kaafi nahi, structure ke saath use karo.

Stop loss kahan lagayein? 🛑

Round number ya entry ke bilkul paas SL = liquidity pool, aksar hit hota hai. Better: swing low/high ke peeche, thoda buffer.

Rule: SL wahan jahan aapka trade idea galat sabit ho. Phir SL se position size nikalo.

Gap up ke baad: fill ya continuation? 🚀

Kal ke close aur aaj ke open ke beech ka khaali hissa = gap. Kabhi price gap fill karta hai, kabhi gap ke upar hold karke aur upar jaata hai.

Dekho: pehle 15-30 min ka high/low, gap ke upar hold, aur volume.
